items.title: Varex Q3 FY2026 Results Show Revenue Growth and Margin Expansion Ahead of Teledyne Transaction
items.summary: Varex Imaging reported higher revenue, stronger non-GAAP margins and improved earnings, although tariff refunds and related customer reimbursements provided a roughly $10 million benefit to quarterly gross profit. Key Investor TakeawaysVarex Imaging (NASDAQ:VREX) reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $211 million, up 4% year over year, with Industrial revenue reaching $77 million and Medical revenue at $134 million.
